AFTER THE FACT -- reading the three passes honestly, and the mechanism S3 points at
(i) S5 passed, but fame lost by being USELESS, not by the biology being strong.
best sequence feature AUC 0.5350; publication count 0.4881, which is 0.5 to within 0.0119.
Fame has no signal on this layer at all, so clearing it is a low bar. The absolute
number is what matters and it is barely above chance.
(ii) S6 is S4 restated through the integrator, not independent confirmation of it.
Both are the same quantity -- gain(bbar, T) -- read once as a threshold and once as
an amplitude. Counting them as two passes would be counting one measurement twice.
(iii) S3 did not merely fail. IT CAME OUT BACKWARDS, and that is the finding.
D-box R..L             ranking: both 0.5917 > transcript only 0.5868 > neither 0.5653 > protein only 0.5553
D-box+ R..L..[LIVM]    ranking: both 0.1657 > transcript only 0.1460 > neither 0.1209 > protein only 0.1125
KEN-box                ranking: both 0.0886 > transcript only 0.0495 > protein only 0.0305 > neither 0.0210
The degron signal sits in BOTH-oscillate, the group that already has a
transcriptional source -- classic APC/C substrates, transcribed periodically AND
destroyed periodically. The 359 protein-only oscillators, the ones that NEED a
post-transcriptional mechanism, carry the LEAST of it. Timed destruction is not
their answer.
(iv) THE MECHANISM THAT IS NOT A TERM IN THE EQUATION: relocalisation.
The CCD call is immunofluorescence intensity per cell. A protein that MOVES between
compartments changes measured intensity without changing copy number, and loop 117
found compartments do move. Tested from the same file as the calls:
1,492 called proteins have a location annotation
MORE THAN ONE COMPARTMENT:  CCD 88.9%  non-CCD 69.0%   difference +19.8%, permutation p = 0.0000
NUCLEUS *AND* CYTOSOL:      CCD 22.8%  non-CCD 27.6%   difference -4.7%, permutation p = 0.0370
nucleus+cytosol,             both: 27.6%
nucleus+cytosol,     protein only: 22.3%

nucleus+cytosol,          neither: 27.4%
AUC(dual localisation) 0.5992   AUC(nucleus+cytosol) 0.4763   against the best sequence feature 0.5350
TRYING TO BREAK IT -- the CCD call and the location call come from the SAME images.
the specific relocalisation signature -- nucleus AND cytosol -- points the WRONG WAY (-4.7%). What separates the groups is the COUNT of compartments, not any
particular pair, which is what an imaging-confidence confound looks like.

It survives stratification, so it is not simply antibody quality -- but reliability
is a coarse proxy for image confidence and this remains a same-instrument
association. It is a hypothesis with a number on it, not a demonstrated mechanism.
